tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.52; also called Bazlith at Neh.7.54;
§ Bazlith or Bazluth = "asking"
a head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel

strongs_1890.derivation: or בַּצְלִית; from the same as H1211 (בֶּצֶל)xlit bᵉtsel corrected to betsel; a peeling;
